title: 112 Teams from 20 States & 6 Countries Debate Emerging AI, IPR Challenges in Chandigarh University's International Moot Court 'Juris Nexus 2026'
description: Chandigarh [India], September 24: Bringing together budding legal minds, judges, eminent legal professionals, researchers and academicians from across the globe, the three-day 'Juris Nexus 2026', India's biggest International Moot Court Competition on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), kicked off at Chandigarh University, providing law students with a platform to gain real-world exposure to emerging legal challenges of the digital age through simulated judicial proceedings, academic exchange and deliberations on cutting-edge legal questions shaping national and international legal frameworks. With a prize pool of over Rs 1.8 lakh, Juris Nexus 2026 features 112 teams from 20 States and six countries representing 13 national law universities, 27 state universities and 67 private higher educational institutions. Chandigarh University Hosts International Moot Court 'Juris Nexus 2026', Bringing Global Legal Minds Together Debate E merging Legal Challenges on AI & IPR in Digital Age.

title: Trump and Xi Jinping head into Washington summit with both leaders thinking time is on their side
description: Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping have a packed agenda for their talks at the White House. The leaders on Thursday are tackling issues like trade irritants, artificial intelligence safeguards, and the war in Iran. Trump wants China to use its influence with Iran, while Xi seeks a halt to U.S. arms sales to Taiwan. A fragile trade truce had been set to expire in November, but the two countries agreed Wednesday to extend it for two months. Trump faces midterm elections, and Xi is dealing with a sluggish economy. Any big breakthroughs in the relationship seem unlikely, but both sides are keen to maintain stability.
